stories.title: Mowi reports record Q3 revenue and profit and raises 2026 harvest guidance to 620,000 tonnes
stories.summary: Revenue reached EUR 1.73 billion on a 186,000 tonne harvest, and operating profit rose 146%. Guidance for 2027 is 630,000 tonnes, with Chile contributing 88,000 tonnes. Mowi declared a quarterly dividend of 2.30 per share, and Q4 contract coverage is 17% in Norway and 23% in Chile. Analysts kept Buy ratings.

stories.title: Agrosuper signs agreement to buy Blumar's salmon business for up to US$540 million
stories.summary: Agrosuper, owner of AquaChile, signed a memorandum of understanding to acquire 100% of Salmones Blumar, valuing it at up to US$540 million. The two firms are negotiating the definitive contracts, and the combination would form the world's second-largest producer. Reports also say Multi X is exploring a purchase of Ventisqueros and that two Chilean producers may be up for sale.

stories.title: BioMar posts record Q3 with EBIT up 50% and raises 2026 guidance
stories.summary: EBIT rose to DKK 618 million (€82.7 million) from DKK 411 million a year earlier, and revenue increased 19%, driven by salmon and Selected Species and higher feed prices. BioMar raised its revenue and EBIT guidance but lowered its volume forecast, expecting a softer Q4 amid uncertain ingredient prices and weaker demand in some markets. The salmon division's operating earnings rose 88% despite lower volumes in Chile, and feed recipes offset sharply higher marine ingredient costs.

SalMar's Q3 operational EBIT doubled on a record 105,100 tonne harvest, but it guides lower Norwegian volumes in Q4 and 347,000 tonnes for 2026.
BioMar's Q3 EBIT rose 50% on higher feed prices and it raised guidance, but it cut its volume forecast and expects a softer Q4 amid uncertain ingredient prices.
Scottish Sea Farms cut its 2026 harvest guidance from 43,000 to 40,000 tonnes after mortality problems that are likely to hit Q4 results.
